security_audit.summary: All 90 static detections appear to be false positives from Markdown formatting and frontend examples. The skill does not include hidden execution, external exfiltration, destructive commands, or audit-bypass prompt injection. Manual npm and npx commands are documented workflow steps, not automatic execution by the skill.

remediation.issue: Manual CLI examples use latest package resolution for shadcn/ui installation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the shadcn CLI version or ask users to review package manager output before running installation commands.

content.value_statement: Frontend work often drifts from product design rules and misses required states. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through consistent React, Next.js, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind changes for Unite-Hub.
actual_capabilities: Applies Unite-Hub design-system checks before creating UI components.
Guides React 19 and Next.js App Router page and route changes.
Uses shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS patterns for consistent components.
Requires workspace filtering for supported Supabase data queries.
Adds loading, error, responsive, accessibility, and performance checks.
limitations: It is written for Unite-Hub and assumes that repository structure.
It provides guidance, not automatic execution or guaranteed review.
It does not define backend APIs or database schemas.
It recommends manual testing but does not run tests by itself.

use_cases.title: Fix Dashboard UI Issues
use_cases.description: Repair layouts, buttons, loading states, and responsive behavior while keeping Unite-Hub design tokens consistent.

use_cases.title: Create New Dashboard Pages
use_cases.description: Add App Router pages, metadata, navigation entries, breadcrumbs, and shadcn/ui sections for new dashboard features.

use_cases.title: Improve Workspace-Safe Interfaces
use_cases.description: Review frontend data views so contacts, campaigns, emails, and generated content stay scoped to the active workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a UI Bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a targeted visual fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix the layout issue on [page]. Follow the design checklist, inspect existing components, and keep shadcn/ui styling consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Dashboard Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new route and navigation entry.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new dashboard page for [feature]. Add metadata, navigation, breadcrumbs, responsive layout, and loading and empty states.

prompt_templates.title: Add Workspace-Safe Data UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a data-driven frontend feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [component] to show [data]. Ensure every supported query is scoped to workspaceId and handles missing workspace state.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Complex Frontend Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for route, state, API, and accessibility review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the [workflow] frontend flow. Check route structure, component reuse, API calls, workspace scoping, errors, accessibility, and mobile behavior.

output_examples.input: Fix the dashboard contact card layout.
output_examples.output: A revised card layout with design-token styling, responsive behavior, loading state, empty state, and error state.

output_examples.input: Add an analytics page to the dashboard.
output_examples.output: A new dashboard route with metadata, navigation, breadcrumbs, shadcn/ui sections, and mobile layout checks.

output_examples.input: Make the Hot Leads Send Email button work.
output_examples.output: A connected button flow with API submission, success toast, failure toast, and workspace-aware contact handling.

best_practices: Read the design system and existing UI components before proposing new markup.
Keep data views scoped to the active workspace before rendering user records.
Verify loading, error, empty, mobile, and keyboard states before finishing work.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic shadcn/ui defaults without Unite-Hub styling tokens.
Do not create data views that omit workspace filtering.
Do not ship pages that only work on desktop viewports.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build and repair Unite-Hub frontend pages, components, routes, layouts, and interaction states.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it target?
faq.answer: It targets React 19, Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui patterns.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and workflows that a developer or agent may choose to run.

faq.question: Does it include backend implementation guidance?
faq.answer: Only at integration points. It focuses on frontend usage of APIs, contexts, and workspace-scoped data.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls for ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen reader support.

faq.question: Is it useful outside Unite-Hub?
faq.answer: Only partly. Many patterns are general, but paths, design tokens, and priorities are Unite-Hub specific.
